candidate.purpose: Official Python REST/WebSocket client for Massive market data (formerly Polygon), including wildcard stock streaming suitable for broad after-hours discovery and trade-level event ingestion.
candidate.latencySuitability: HIGH with appropriate market-data entitlement; WebSocket wildcard subscriptions can remove the polling/universe-preselection blind spot.
candidate.maintenance: Official maintained client; recent 2026 maintenance observed during this sweep.
candidate.docsTests: README and core examples document REST and WebSocket clients, including wildcard stock subscriptions. Production integration still requires a sandbox reconnect/backpressure benchmark.
candidate.securityNotes: Requires API credentials and market-data entitlement. Keys must remain server-side; never expose them in GitHub Pages/browser code. Add reconnect, rate-limit, backpressure and malformed-event guards.
candidate.lookAheadBiasRisk: LOW for live streaming when exchange/event timestamps are preserved; historical backfill must remain causally separated from signal-time state.
candidate.integrationPlan: Sandbox a Massive wildcard WebSocket adapter against current Yahoo polling. Compare p50/p95 Time-to-Detection, AH symbol coverage, trade/TPM availability, reconnect recovery, event ordering, operating cost and false-positive lift. Do not add to production until benchmarked.
